trial_title: Safety and Efficacy Trial of Oral Testosterone Undecanoate (TU) in Hypogonadal Men
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the safety and efficacy of an oral testosterone undecanoate formulation for use as testosterone-replacement therapy in men with low testosterone.
